surface: The autocomplete editor: opening it on a cell, arrowing through its choices, typing to narrow the list, and Enter committing the choice.

steps.note: Enter opens the editor on the cell holding `Al`: a text field with the combobox role over a listbox of the choices that match `Al` (Alpha, Alfa, Alto). Required: the text, the role and the open list (`expanded`, on every reader). NVDA reads the field (`combo box, collapsed, has auto complete, editable, Al`) and then `expanded`. Finding: VoiceOver reads the list that opens instead of the field (`expanded list box A, row 1` with Chromium, `expanded list A, row 1 3 items` with WebKit), so it says neither the text nor the combo box role.

ArrowDown highlights the first choice. The focus stays in the text field and aria-activedescendant names the option, and every reader reads it with its position: NVDA `list. Alpha, 1 of 3`, VoiceOver with Chromium `Alpha menu item, group (1 of 3)`, VoiceOver with WebKit `Alpha selected (1 of 3)`. The same on this step and the next two.

Typing `f` after `Al` rebuilds the list with Alfa, the one choice that matches `Alf`, and leaves no choice highlighted; the polite live region says what is left, so the change is read without a focus move (4.1.3). NVDA reads `Alfa` (with Firefox after the window title and the document), and VoiceOver with Chromium `Alfa menu item` and the field's text. Finding: VoiceOver with WebKit reads only the typed letter, `f`.
ArrowDown highlights Alfa, the one choice left, so that Enter commits it: without this step Enter commits the typed text, `Alf`. Finding: nothing is said on any reader when the highlight lands on it.

Enter commits Alfa and moves the selection one row down (enterMoves), to the next row's cell, which holds `Al`. Required: that cell's value and its row. The focus reaches the cell and every reader reads it (NVDA `Al, A, row 3, column 2`). VoiceOver names no row on any cell move (its behavior, grid-core).
ArrowUp moves to the edited cell, which now holds the committed choice, `Alfa`. Every reader reads the cell: the arrow key takes the focus from the closed field back to the grid.
